coordinate_convention: GLB scene coordinates: (x, z, -y) from STEP; Y-up, right-handed; scale strictly [1.0, 1.0, 1.0] for physical metric integrity

battery_rack.source_origin: DJI Official CMS STEP (RoboMaster Battery Rack compatible)
battery_rack.basis: Rack placed at origin as the stationary mounting foundation. Bottom mount face (-Y) and side mount face (-Z) align with chassis coordinate frames.

battery_tb47d.source_origin: Local SERS STEP archive (directory name does not certify manufacturer authorization)

separated_candidate.basis: User guide v1.2 p.6/p.12 shows vertical top insertion along +Y opening. Lifting battery by +0.10m completely avoids false collision/penetration, reveals bottom contact surfaces and rack internal cavity terminal pads cleanly.
separated_candidate.penetration_check: Zero penetration; clearance between battery bottom and rack top is approximately 30.5mm.

seated_candidate.basis: Geometric placement reference: aligns battery main slab (73x40mm) into rack opening, setting battery bottom plate at rack cavity floor support level (Y ≈ -0.015m).
uncertainties_and_risks: Source STEPs lack latch micro-geometry, guide rails, and spring contact deflect geometry.
TB47D terminal cluster located on lateral wings does not directly mate with rack terminal pads without an unmodeled intermediate adapter board.
No mechanical tolerance or interference analysis has been certified by physical testing.
